title: Data disposition registry v1
description: One row per persistence owner in packages/schemas/planning-schema.sql, stating how long it is kept, what an Article 17 erasure does to it, whether it is inside the database backup set, and which worker enforces the window. docs/privacy/DATA_MAP.md is the Article 30 record and the prose authority; this file is the machine-readable form of the windows it states.

classification.description: personal identifies a natural person directly or through a live mapping the controller holds; pseudonymous identifies one only through a binding that an erasure destroys; non-personal never identifies one.

attribution_retention.description: How long the ability to link a pseudonymous row to a person is kept, where that differs from how long the row is kept. Present only on pseudonymous rows.

erasure_action.description: delete removes the row; key-destroy-retain keeps it and destroys the key that binds it to a person; retain-pseudonymous keeps a row that was never bound to a person by a destroyable key; retain-unlinked keeps a row whose subject row is deleted; not-applicable means an erasure never reaches it.

expiry_enforcement.description: Required for every table carrying an expires_at column. Names what acts when the timestamp passes; an expiry with no actor is a comment.

policy_key.description: A key in packages/schemas/policy-defaults-v1.json. The value there governs.

rule.description: A window that no clock expresses, tied to the life of another aggregate.
